audit.why: Favoured all seven stages (51% WR, chart all-Qiyana) matches prose: immobile Brand dies to burst, stays killable late if flanked.
Spikes at L3-5 dive window, L6 wall-R, first item one-rotation, late knife-edge — consistent and grounded in both kits.

audit.whatIsWrong: winCon and dosFull[1].t reference 'his post-combo silence' / 'string the silence' — Brand has no silence anywhere in his kit. Also breakdown.cooldowns carried no digits and two lint bleeds.
audit.why: Kit: Brand P Blaze, Q Sear (stun only on Ablaze, 8/7.5/7/6.5/6s), W Pillar of Flame 10-8s, E Conflagration 13-9s, R Pyroclasm 100/90/80s. No silence exists.
audit.corrected: Silence references replaced with the real Sear-on-Ablaze condition; real cooldowns added.

edits.before: Deny the aim, string the silence, and stun the wall he forgot existed. Keep one eye on Sear (Stun) and one on the wave, in that order.
edits.after: Stay unstacked so Sear cannot stun, then stun the wall he forgot existed. Keep one eye on his Q and one on the wave, in that order.

edits.before: Grass-Q from stealth, E-ice the answer, auto, walk back into the hedge — terrain trades he experiences as ambush weather.
edits.after: Once W and E are burned he has an 8-13 second hole with nothing but a stun that needs you Ablaze — E in and finish the string there.

edits.before: E-ing in with no element loaded and his CC banked — Qiyana without terrain prep is a dagger doing improv.
edits.after: Rock-Q is your execute line — thrown at a full health bar it is just poke; save it for the sub-half burst.

edits.before: - Brand Sear (Stun): matchup-defining — Q only stuns when you are ablaze — after eating W or E, the stun line is the dodge that matters. Count it out loud if you must. - Your W Terrashape (element swap) has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Brand Sear (Q, 8s at rank 1, 6s max): only stuns when you are Ablaze — after eating W or E, the stun line is the dodge that matters. - Pillar of Flame (W) runs 10-8s; dodge it and he has no stack, no stun. - Pyroclasm is 100s — your R answers the fight his cannot reach.
